Publication statement: Philadelphia : Published by H.S. Tanner, 1846.

Relief shown by hachures. Cover title: Tanner's travelling map of Mexico. Prime meridian: Washington. "Entered according to Act of Congress, the 2nd day of April 1832, by H.S. Tanner, of the state of Pennsylvania." Includes "Statistical Table" and "Table of Distances." Inset: Map of the roads &c from Vera Cruz & Alvarado to Mexico. LC copy imperfect: Darkened, fold-lined with minor losses, mounted on cloth backing. Annotated in lead pencil in lower left corner: Millard Fillmore's copy. Signed inside cover: Millard Fillmore, May 21, 1846. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Signed inside cover: Millard Fillmore, May 21, 1846.
